text.p: The Dow Industrials moved higher in early trading on Tuesday, bouncing back from a small sell-off on Friday and bolstered by renewed merger activity.
The Dow Industrials was up 15 at 7,003 at the start following Monday's holiday. The Nasdaq Composite was up three at 1,370, while the S&P Index was up one at 809
As Wall Street opened the 30-year long bond was unchanged to yield 6.53 percent.
